messages.subject: Project Lyra — draft term sheet for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Gregory,

Attached is a first draft term sheet reflecting the commercial heads we discussed: £6m upfront, development milestones to £44m, sales milestones to £105m, and tiered royalties of 8/11/14%. I've left the liability section open — our opening position is uncapped for the core grant and IP warranties, which Calderbrook will resist.

Grateful for any comments before we send to Birchall Stone.

Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield | Partner, Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0118
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
